drivingQuestion: What does the word 'she' in the mishna teach?
outcomeNote: The word restricts the concern to the known co-wife

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ מַאי ״הִיא צָרָתָהּ״? הָא קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן: לְהָא צָרָה הוּא דְּחָיְישִׁינַן, אֲבָל לְצָרָה אַחֲרִיתִי לָא חָיְישִׁינַן.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara asks: «What is» implied by the extra word: She, in the expression in the first clause of the mishna: Whether «she,» i.e., «her rival wife, is» pregnant? The Gemara answers that it «teaches us this: We are concerned» about a possible pregnancy of «this rival wife» who went overseas with her husband, «but we are not concerned about» the possibility that he married «another rival wife» overseas and sired a child by her.
